descriptions.w3d_actor_special_flag: Tests whether the held special interface has a nonzero integer value.
descriptions.w3d_actor_lock_for_team_message: Locks the matching team actor, releases its enabled interface, and applies a timer and positional effect.
descriptions.w3d_actor_unlock_for_team_message: Unlocks the matching team actor and updates its timer and actor value.
descriptions.w3d_actor_post_team_message: Posts an integer message containing the actor team.
descriptions.w3d_actor_ground_cast_clear: Tests whether a short ground cast exceeds its distance threshold.
descriptions.w3d_actor_start_jump: Records the jump origin, starts a jump, or changes the state for a quick repeated jump.
descriptions.w3d_actor_post_player_effect: Posts a positional effect selected by the current player setting.
descriptions.w3d_actor_clear_active_state: Clears the actor active field, updates the cleanup handle, and runs the base reset.
descriptions.w3d_actor_camera_target_position: Copies actor position and raises its vertical component for camera targeting.
descriptions.w3d_actor_create_third_link: Creates and retains the third linked object, fills its fields, and registers it with the service.
descriptions.w3d_actor_has_active_link: Returns whether any of three linked object queries is active.
